title: FTO pre-screen (not a legal opinion): Evidence test LNP
limits:
Important notice – limits of this FTO pre-screen
1. This is an automated (AI-assisted) pre-screen. It is not legal advice and not a freedom-to-operate opinion, and it does not replace review by a patent attorney.
2. The screened corpus is restricted to the LNP/lipid field (EP/US/WO; defined CPC classes, keywords and applicants). Rights outside this restriction – including utility models, national rights of other countries and supplementary protection certificates – are not covered.
3. Markush/generic claims may cover structures that are not individually indexed in the corpus. No Markush search (e.g. CAS STN MARPAT) was performed. The formula test is only applied to claims whose text is in the corpus; formulae embedded as images may be missing.
4. Legal status (grant, opposition, limitation, lapse, term, PTA/PTE, SPC, UPC opt-out) reflects a data snapshot of 2026-08-23 and may be stale or incomplete. Expiry dates are estimates.
5. Claim texts may be machine translations or OCR text; only the text in the language of proceedings, as granted or maintained, is authoritative.
6. Pending applications: claims may change before grant; divisionals and continuations may be filed. Applications not yet published (up to 18 months from priority) are not covered.
7. The assessment rests on the product/process data and assumptions listed under "Subject of the screen". If they change, the result changes.
8. Claim construction, equivalence and exemptions (experimental use, Bolar, safe harbor) depend on the individual case and current case law; prosecution files were not reviewed.
9. AI models make mistakes (wrong substituent mapping, wrong chain-length counts, overlooked provisos). Verify quotes and feature mappings against the original document before any decision.

descriptors.zaehlkonvention: Computed by the app (OpenChemLib), not by the model. A chain (kette) is a hydrocarbon group of 6 or more carbons on one hetero atom or carbonyl carbon; c_atoms of an acyl chain (app.acyl = true) INCLUDES the carbonyl carbon; verzweigungsposition counts from the atom the chain hangs on; arms = chain lengths after the first branch point; n_double_bonds_cc counts C=C in the chains only.

text.label: LNP with cationic/ionizable lipid (independent claims)
text.query: same:(("lipid nanoparticle" OR "lipid nanoparticles" OR "nucleic acid-lipid particle" OR "lipid particle" OR "lipid particles" OR lipidnanopartikel OR "lipid-nanopartikel" OR "lipidpartikel" OR liposom* OR "lipid vesicle") AND ("cationic lipid" OR "ionizable lipid" OR "ionisable lipid" OR "amino lipid" OR "kationisches lipid" OR "kationische lipid" OR "ionisierbares lipid" OR "ionisierbare lipid")) indep:1

text.label: Molar ratios / mol-%
text.query: same:(("cationic lipid" OR "ionizable lipid" OR "ionisable lipid" OR "amino lipid" OR "kationisches lipid" OR "kationische lipid" OR "ionisierbares lipid" OR "ionisierbare lipid") AND ("mol %" OR "mol%" OR "mol percent" OR "molar ratio" OR molprozent OR "mol-%" OR "molverhältnis") AND (cholesterol OR cholesterin OR sterol OR phospholipid OR "non-cationic lipid" OR "neutral lipid")) indep:1

text.label: PEG-/polymer-conjugated lipid
text.query: same:(("conjugated lipid" OR "peg-lipid" OR "pegylated lipid" OR "peg lipid" OR "polymer conjugated lipid" OR "polyethylene glycol" OR "pegyliertes lipid" OR "polyethylenglykol") AND ("lipid nanoparticle" OR "lipid nanoparticles" OR "nucleic acid-lipid particle" OR "lipid particle" OR "lipid particles" OR lipidnanopartikel OR "lipid-nanopartikel" OR "lipidpartikel" OR liposom* OR "lipid vesicle")) indep:1

text.label: Lipid compound claims with a generic formula (C07C/C07D)
text.query: indep:("compound of formula" OR "lipid of formula" OR "compound having" OR "having the structure" OR "following structure" OR "verbindung der formel" OR "lipid der formel" OR "compound of the formula") cpc:C07C,C07D

text.label: Payload mRNA in LNP
text.query: same:((mrna OR "messenger rna" OR "messenger ribonucleic acid" OR "ribonucleic acid" OR rna OR boten*) AND ("lipid nanoparticle" OR "lipid nanoparticles" OR "nucleic acid-lipid particle" OR "lipid particle" OR "lipid particles" OR lipidnanopartikel OR "lipid-nanopartikel" OR "lipidpartikel" OR liposom* OR "lipid vesicle") AND ("cationic lipid" OR "ionizable lipid" OR "ionisable lipid" OR "amino lipid" OR "kationisches lipid" OR "kationische lipid" OR "ionisierbares lipid" OR "ionisierbare lipid")) indep:1

text.label: Manufacturing process (mixing, ethanol, microfluidics)
text.query: same:((mixing OR mischen OR vermischen OR "t-connector" OR "t-junction" OR microfluidic* OR mikrofluid* OR herringbone OR "impinging jet") AND (ethanol OR alcohol OR alkohol OR "organic solvent") AND lipid* AND (nanoparticle* OR particle* OR vesicle* OR liposom* OR partikel* OR nanopartikel*)) indep:1

text.label: Particle parameters (size, PDI)
text.query: same:((diameter OR durchmesser OR "particle size" OR polydispersity OR polydispersität* OR "mean size") AND ("lipid nanoparticle" OR "lipid nanoparticles" OR "nucleic acid-lipid particle" OR "lipid particle" OR "lipid particles" OR lipidnanopartikel OR "lipid-nanopartikel" OR "lipidpartikel" OR liposom* OR "lipid vesicle") AND ("cationic lipid" OR "ionizable lipid" OR "ionisable lipid" OR "amino lipid" OR "kationisches lipid" OR "kationische lipid" OR "ionisierbares lipid" OR "ionisierbare lipid")) indep:1

limits: Ranges were found by pattern rules in the claim text; ranges that sit only in formula images or tables are not seen.
Units are normalised (mol %, wt %, nm, Da, mg/mL, ratio a:b as a/b); "about" is treated as the stated number, although it can widen the claimed range.
A claim range with a bare "%" does not state whether it is by mol or by weight: it is compared with values of either basis and marked "basis not stated".

The component (ionizable lipid, PEG lipid, ...) is attributed by the nearest component word in the same clause: a heuristic. A value with a component is compared with the ranges attributed to that component; if the claim has none, with ranges whose component could not be identified (marked "component not identified": the range may belong to another component).
A dependent claim takes over the ranges of the claims it refers to unless it states the same parameter itself.
A value inside a stated range is not an infringement finding: other claim features decide. Pre-screening, not legal advice.
